components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Primary execution CTA used in SPA Toast and empty states.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; border: none; height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Neutral Button
components.description: Low-emphasis secondary action paired with Primary Action Button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { position: relative; background: #eaeef4; color: #464f5e; border: 1px solid #dfe4ec; height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #dfe4ec; color: #111318; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Concentric Command Search Box
components.description: NewTab command/URL input with concentric inner engine switcher and / keycap.
components.html: /
components.css: .ds-search-box { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 0 9px 0 5px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dfe4ec; border-radius: 11px; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out, box-shadow 140ms ease-out; } .ds-search-box:focus-within { border-color: #2563eb; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22); } .ds-engine { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 28px; padding: 0 8px 0 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #eaeef4; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #464f5e; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; outline: none; font-size: 13px; color: #111318; } .ds-kbd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #525d70; background: #eaeef4; border: 1px solid #c8d0dc; border-radius: 5px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #c8d0dc; }

components.name: Group Filter Chip
components.description: Group rail tab with tabular count and active Cobalt Wash state.
components.css: .ds-gchip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.09); color: #2563eb; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out, transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-gchip:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-gchip-n { font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: YiTab is built as a quiet, engineered desktop utility where chrome disappears behind speed and clarity. The system rejects decorative gradients, rainbow progress tracks, high-saturation pill badges, and stacked white cards in favor of calibrated tonal slate surfaces, crisp 1px structural hairlines, and a single authoritative Cobalt Signal accent reserved strictly for active focus, primary execution, and live state.
keyCharacteristics: Calibrated three-step neutral surface ladder (canvas -> surface -> surface-well) in cool slate (light) and deep obsidian-graphite (dark).
Single-declaration layered shadows for floating/deck elevation (--shadow-deck, --shadow-popover); 1px solid hairlines reserved strictly for structural dividers.
Zero external font/CDN dependencies; native system UI sans paired with monospace strictly for domains, ports, IPs, and keycaps.
Keyboard-first ergonomics (/ focus, arrow selection, Enter activation, Esc dismiss, Tab traversal) with >= 40px extended hit areas and tactile scale(0.96) press feedback.

rules.name: The Single-Accent Discipline Rule
rules.body: Cobalt Signal never appears as decorative gradients or multi-hue badges; it marks only the primary action, keyboard focus, or current active selection.

rules.name: The Neutral Image Outline Rule
rules.body: Favicon frames carry a pure neutral inset outline (oklch(0 0 0 / 0.1) light, oklch(1 0 0 / 0.1) dark) so surrounding surface tint never bleeds onto icon edges.

rules.name: The Monospace Truth Rule
rules.body: Monospace is used strictly for domains, IP/port addresses, and keyboard keycaps—never as decorative labels on prose or headings.

rules.name: The Single-Boundary Elevation Rule
rules.body: Cards and overlays declare their outer edge once via layered box-shadow; internal structural separation uses 1px solid var(--hairline) borders only.

dos: Do keep every interactive target at >= 40px hit area (via non-colliding ::after hit-slop when visual size is compact).
Do specify exact CSS transition properties (110ms–150ms ease-out) and honor @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
Do apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to every dynamic count, clock, and result tally.
Do add explicit :focus-visible 2px solid var(--accent) outlines inside Shadow DOM roots after all: initial.
donts: Don't use linear gradients, rainbow countdown bars, or multi-hue decorative pills anywhere on Operate surfaces.
Don't place a vertical accent bar down one side of a rounded list row (::before side stripe); use full-perimeter inset rings or surface tint.
Don't use Unicode emoji as UI icons; render uniform 1.5px-stroke vector SVGs.
Don't use display: none for keyboard-reachable row actions or transition: all on interactive controls.
